Overall very average. The night staff was very rude, especially the person sitting at the reception. Even internet was not working most of the time. Rooms were very conjusted, washrooms were average. Even given bottles were too small for 2 people.
The 2 things I like were the parking person who was very nice and the food hall in the basement. The food was also good
